scope: New offline research only. Ancestor experiments and all production paths immutable. No account/order/Pi/deploy endpoints.

universe.rule: Enumerate ALL archive USDT prefixes including delisted assets, not exchangeInfo survivors. Download available monthly daily bars 2019-2025. At each completed UTC day admit symbols with >=365 observed daily bars, finite positive actual OHLCV, rolling30 mean quote-volume >=10m USD, then top10 liquidity. No fixed 2020 cohort; new listings can enter after warmup. Intraday data acquisition may be restricted to the union of eligible symbols, but eligibility itself uses the entire archive census and only past/current completed data.
universe.identity: Exact venue-symbol, no ticker aliases, no synthetic BASE or substituted returns. Record first/last observed trade dates and gaps separately from administrative notices. Known delisting notices use publication timestamp and a 72h exit buffer; retrospective last-observed dates never authorize earlier exits. Missing held quotes fail safely, not zero-filled returns. Unverified notice coverage stays explicit.

execution.minimum_order_note: Explicit conservative research assumption, not an authenticated historical symbol-filter reconstruction. Fractional units; lot/tick precision uncertainty remains disclosed. Model capacity is not a live Hyperliquid capacity claim.
execution.orders: Fixed target quantities at an executable decision; sells before buys, common cash budget allocated proportionally among competing buys. Partial fills limited by 0.1% latest closed and published 4h quote-volume (i-2), per-symbol aggregate budget, adverse open fill and full fees. Residual quantities persist up to fixed TTL; a changed target cancels stale orders. Entry TTL cancels residual, keeps real fills and cash. Exit TTL with residual held quantity fails closed. Below-minimum entry stays pending then cancels; below-minimum exit is dust, remains marked and explicitly flagged; no fictitious close.
execution.rebalance: Weekly Sunday close or calendar month-end close; no drift rebalancing between decisions. Immediate causal liquidation intent when a held symbol loses eligibility or required positive momentum. No immediate replacement until scheduled decision.
execution.fold_boundary: Start each year flat with only available warmup target. Additional fill delay applies to this initial order too. Predeclared end-of-year liquidation begins 18 bars before the last bar; stress delays intent by one bar. No entry after liquidation starts. Unclosed material positions at year end reject that account replay; never force fill at close.
execution.dust: Residual exit below 10 USD cannot be fictitiously closed. At fold end any residual > 0.01 USD rejects complete flat-to-flat performance; retain partial evidence. This conservative minimum-notional limitation is reported separately from volume capacity.
execution.capacity: Five independent initial capitals with OOS compounding. Parameters selected only on $100 development, reused unchanged at every capital. Largest execution-safe TESTED capital requires all four folds close safely. Faithful capacity additionally requires >=95% requested entry notional filled before cancel/TTL in nominal and cost/delay stresses. No interpolation beyond tested grid.

B_rules: Prior experiment momentum horizons, vol60 floor0.1, positive-momentum filter, blend and cadences retained. Only user-requested top2/top3 inverse-volatility portfolio and relative-only comparison added. Blend averages 30/90/180/365 momentum, with lookback canonicalized to90 when inactive. Rank eligible actual symbols; relative-only may hold negative momentum. Top2/3 inverse max(vol60,0.1) weights sum1; missing constituents leave corresponding cash, never borrow another asset return.
fixed_comparisons: 24 prespecified variants at 90-day non-blended momentum: top_k1/2/3 x vol_adjusted false/true x absolute false/true x weekly/monthly. Nominal OOS at all five capitals, cost/delay stress at primary$100. This is a descriptive factorial panel, not post-OOS selection. All four horizons separately included in evolution seed population.

evolution.validation: Previous calendar year only. Each arm starts identical 10 candidates and has equal 22-evaluation budget per origin. Reset populations per origin. No prior experiment performance or outer OOS sent to proposer. API failures fall back deterministically and remain labeled; unavailable AI is not claimed to be AI evolution.

selection.feasible: Positive dev CAGR and both stresses, DD<=35%, safe closes, then benchmark noninferiority gate. Pareto ranks then MDD asc, Calmar desc, Sharpe desc, CAGR desc, turnover asc, lexical ID. No feasible row => explicitly rejected diagnostic, never PASS.
selection.finalists: Freeze per-arm robust (same champion rule), aggressive (highest CAGR on valid Pareto), compromise (highest Calmar on feasible Pareto) using 2025 development before any outer evaluation. No prospective data opened.

benchmark.name: BTC_SMA200
benchmark.rules: Concrete BTC spot above daily SMA200 long, else CASH; same PIT, fees, fills, TTL, capital and planned annual close
benchmark.comparison: At least one meaningful gain: CAGR+5pp OR MDD-5pp OR Sharpe+0.15 OR Calmar+0.25 OR max positive-profit asset share-0.15 OR one additional profitable annual fold. No material deterioration: CAGR>=benchmark-10pp; MDD<=benchmark+5pp; Sharpe>=benchmark-0.20; Calmar>=benchmark-0.30; profitable folds>=benchmark-1; positive-profit asset concentration<=benchmark+0.15 when defined. Undefined concentration cannot count as improvement. Development uses only return/risk/concentration metrics, no single-year fold count gain.

stress.neighbors: All adjacent enum values, canonicalized/deduplicated. Primary-capital previous-year validation only; never reselection. >=75% executable positive CAGR and DD<=35%, median CAGR>=75% parent positive CAGR.

metrics: Actual cash+asset quantities. CAGR elapsed UTC365.25, daily Sharpe sample std, conservative portfolio high/low intrabar MDD, Calmar positive loss magnitude. Fees/slippage/funding separated. Multiasset episode log attribution uses exact proportional allocation of each simultaneous NAV change, fees assigned to traded asset; sums must reconcile total log NAV. Top3 removes complete episode account log contributions, not standalone coin returns. Also report gross-positive profit shares and dollar/turnover concentration, well-defined for losing portfolios.

D.data_gate: Acquire actual Binance USD-M trade4h, mark4h, timestamped funding for the five declared contracts. Require complete historical versioned maintenance brackets, liquidation/insurance fees and rules, listing/delisting and fee evidence for every tested interval. A current authenticated bracket endpoint is not historical evidence and no exchange account key is read. Exact missing intervals per symbol/component saved. If any gate remains missing, all affected recipes remain NOT_RUN; no spot or fabricated short/perp performance.

C: ARCHIVED_REJECT; no mutations or replays in this follow-up
A: Prior experiment REJECT retained, no new search
E: Require at least two independently qualifying families among new B and D, main numeric+stress+benchmark gates, on >=2 earlier OOS folds. Failed A/C never enter, nor two correlated B variants renamed as separate families. If qualified use equal notional components, same execution ledger; otherwise NOT_RUN_NO_QUALIFIED_MEMBERS.

deepseek.peak_utc: Mon-Fri01:00-04:00,06:00-10:00 excluding Chinese public holidays; unknown holiday uses conservative peak estimate
deepseek.input: Only current-origin development whitelist and parameter schema. No files/tools/code/evaluator/metrics changes, OOS/sealed payload forbidden.
deepseek.output: Strict JSON exactly candidates:[four configurations]. Validate key set/types/enums/canonicalization. Record accepted, duplicate/invalid rejected proposals, reasons, usage and tariff-estimated cost. Never store credentials.
deepseek.key_source: Named process environment or Windows current-user environment DEEPSEEK_API_KEY/MRV1_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY only; never repository dotenv or other secrets.

sealed.rule: Existing history is not newly sealed. Forward candidate freeze precedes any prospective outcome access. No validated production winner claim without future evidence.
